desc: Original Burberry cotton piqué polos, eight colourways in one listing: five plain (8099164 green, 8096425 black, 8099165 navy, 8099166 white, 8099167 beige) and three with the Burberry Check collar (8071620 black, 8072661 navy, 8071621 white). Regular fit, short sleeves, 100% cotton, embroidered Equestrian Knight logo at the chest. Sold in packs of 10 per colourway (S×1 · M×3 · L×3 · XL×2 · XXL×1) — enter the quantity per colourway in multiples of 10; the stock on hand per size is listed on this page.
